name: astro
description: Astro + TypeScript + Content Collections. Targets developers building content-heavy sites: marketing pages, documentation sites, blogs, landing pages. Astro's islands architecture lets users mix React/Vue/Svelte/Solid components selectively, so this preset keeps the broader frontend toolkit (`dev-frontend-design`, `dev-shadcn`, `dev-react-perf`, `qa-chrome`, `qa-design`) and only filters out clearly non-applicable skills (mobile, homelab, the Next.js framework specifically). Bundles ZERO marketplace plugins at v1 — Astro-specific plugin curation will be added incrementally as each one is validated in real production use, not assumed.
outOfScope: Native mobile companion — use a Flutter or Swift preset (community contributions wanted)
Heavy SSR/full-stack backend logic — pair with the fastapi preset for a Python API, or use the nextjs preset if you need a JS-native fullstack with extensive server logic
Homelab IaC — use the homelab-proxmox preset for Proxmox/Terraform/Ansible patterns
Real-time / streaming apps — Astro excels at SSG and selective hydration; for heavy streaming UIs, SvelteKit or Next.js are better fits
Toolchain choice (uv vs pdm vs pip, ruff vs flake8) — Python is rarely the primary stack for Astro, but if backend services are added see docs/recipes/python-toolchain-options.md
